name: Amazon KDP — Low-Content & AI-Assisted Books

yield.notes: Per-title earnings are low; income scales with catalog size. AI-assisted content creation can dramatically speed up catalog building.

flags: Amazon can suppress or remove listings without notice
AI content policy: must disclose AI-generated content per Amazon TOS

startup_checklist: Research low-competition niches using Publisher Rocket or free KDP category browsing
Create first book (journal, planner, or AI-assisted niche book) with Canva or Book Bolt
Set price at $6.99–$9.99 for 70% royalty tier
Publish and check sales dashboard weekly for first 30 days
failure_modes: Account suspended for violating AI content disclosure policy
Title ranks poorly due to no keyword optimization
Low-content books commoditized — price race to bottom
kill_criteria: Zero sales after 60 days with ≥10 titles published
Amazon policy changes make AI content non-viable
kpis: Units sold per title per month
sources_note: Royalty rates and policies from Amazon KDP official docs.
